title: Learn TypeScript
description: From first types to confidently typing real-world apps.

nodes.title: Set up TypeScript
nodes.description: Install tsc, create tsconfig.json and compile your first file.

nodes.title: Basic types
nodes.description: Use string, number, boolean, arrays and tuples with annotations.

nodes.title: Typed functions
nodes.description: Type parameters, return values, optional and default params.

nodes.title: Interfaces & type aliases
nodes.description: Model objects with interfaces and type aliases; know when to use which.

nodes.title: Unions & narrowing
nodes.description: Combine types with unions and narrow them with typeof, in and discriminants.

nodes.title: Generics
nodes.description: Write reusable generic functions and types with constraints.

nodes.title: Utility types
nodes.description: Use Partial, Pick, Omit, Record and ReturnType in real code.

nodes.title: Typing async code
nodes.description: Type Promises, async functions and API responses safely.

nodes.title: TypeScript with React
nodes.description: Type props, state, events and hooks in a React component.

nodes.title: Capstone: typed app
nodes.description: Build a small app with strict mode on and zero any.
